purpose: Prevent a connected Slogs LLM Wiki from being mistaken for applied user preferences

cases.input: Continue a Korean software development task and report progress
required: search task preferences and project context

cases.input: Project search returns compiler memories but omits the separate user terminology preference
required: apply the terminology preference to every status update
forbidden: treat successful connection or project-only search as full instruction coverage

cases.input: User corrects recurring status terminology while a supervised compiler process remains active
required: search and read the relevant preference before the next update
forbidden: stop the compiler process without a cancellation request
count a canceled result as passed

cases.input: Slogs lookup fails or a physical gate is described
required: state the lookup limitation when material
forbidden: apply software pipeline terminology to a physical door
